settings.first_text:
Key Features

  • Material Choices: Available in 13 oz standard or 16 oz premium thick vinyl to suit different display needs
  • Vibrant Visuals: 720 DPI eco-solvent printing on 13 oz vinyl produce crisp, vibrant graphics and 600 DPI UV printing on 16 oz vinyl delivers UV and fade-resistant graphics
  • Durable Construction: High-quality PVC flex resists tears and water for indoor and outdoor use
  • Secure Mounting: Brass grommets, pole pockets, and adhesive tabs support stable installation
  • Custom Designs: Choose standard or custom sizes with single or double-sided printing
  • Optional Wind Slits: Optional wind slits help reduce wind pressure for improved outdoor performance

Custom Vinyl Banners for Indoor and Outdoor Use

Promote your brand with custom vinyl banners made for clear visibility in any setting. Suitable for storefronts, trade shows, outdoor festivals, sports events, and real estate and construction site signage, they deliver clear, professional branding wherever they are installed. Lightweight and easy to handle, these heavy-duty vinyl banners work equally well for short-term promotions and long-term outdoor display.

Durable PVC Flex Built for Outdoor Performance

Constructed from high-quality PVC Flex, these outdoor vinyl banners are available in 13 oz standard or 16 oz premium thick vinyl to match different display needs. The tear-resistant and water-resistant material is built to perform across outdoor conditions, while heat-welded seams help prevent fraying and extend the banner’s lifespan. 720 DPI eco-solvent printing delivers high-resolution output with true-to-color accuracy and 600 DPI UV printing delivers UV and fade resistance. Add lamination for extra protection in demanding outdoor environments.

Full Customization with Professional Design Support

Choose from standard or custom sizes to match your display needs. Select single-sided or double-sided printing based on where the banner will be placed. You can design online or upload your artwork, with free design assistance and proof review included before your vinyl banner order goes to production. Our custom banner printing services ensure every banner is produced with sharp graphics, vibrant colors, and professional-quality results.

Easy Setup, Versatile Use, Low Maintenance

Rust-free brass grommets suit fence and flat-surface installation, pole pockets at the top only, top and bottom, or left and right slot onto rods and poles, and adhesive tabs work where no hardware is needed. These installation options make vinyl banners a practical choice for fence banners used at sports fields, construction sites, and outdoor event venues. For large-format banners in high-wind locations, add wind slits to let air pass through the material. Vinyl banner's maintenance is easy, just wipe clean with a soft, damp cloth and are ready to reuse. Order your custom vinyl banners today and get them delivered straight to your door.
settings.second_text:
Graphic Material & Printing

  • Material: High Quality PVC Flex
  • Weight: Standard 13 oz / Premium 16 oz
  • Print Technology: 720 DPI Eco Solvent (for 13 oz fabric), 600 DPI UV Printing (for 16 oz fabric)
  • Print Sides: Single-Sided / Double-Sided
  • Color Configuration: Front White / Back Gray
  • Size Tolerance: Up to 5 feet: ±0.5 inch

Construction & Finishing

  • Edge Finish: Heat-Welded Edges
  • Mounting Options: Rust-Resistant Brass Grommets / Composite Film Adhesive Tabs / Pole Pockets
  • Application: Indoor & Outdoor

Care & Maintenance

  • Wipe with soft damp cloth.
  • Avoid harsh chemicals.
